title: SC registry flags over 10 defects in Rahul Gandhi's plea in SIR case
description:
The Supreme Court registry on Monday flagged more than 10 defects in the petition filed by Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and others over alleged large-scale voter deletions and irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
According to sources, the registry asked the filing lawyer to submit a clear copy of the ID card of Congress president and Leader of Opposition in Rajya Sabha Mallikarjun Kharge, who is one of the co-petitioners in the case.
The registry also flagged certain illegible or missing pages in the petition, sources said.
Besides, the registry also pointed out a shortfall of over Rs 200 in court fee.
Earlier in the day, Gandhi and several other opposition leaders marched to the apex court to file the petition.
